## Key construction decisions (recorded in the notes)

- All seven declared prerequisite pages are **published** (inherited), so the batch has no in-run consumer dependency; the cross-batch ledger shows batch 9 only as a supplier to batches 10/11.
- Five prerequisite rows were added on the A page (boundary collapse of framed cobordisms; path-connectedness of positive bases; based vs free sphere-map classes; the stabilized framed-bordism colimit; stabilization ↔ suspension).
- Recorded deviations: framed cobordism is collar-decorated to fix boundary signs; the fixed-codimension theorem is stated for `n ≥ k ≥ 1`; the design's B2 "standard framed equator → suspension generator" was corrected (the canonical equatorial framing is null-cobordant per Freed Exercise 5.34 — the generator is a framed point); B3 computes π₃(S²) through the fibration LES without Hopf-invariant theory.
